design.purpose: A small raised display stand for one lightweight LEGO figure or similar small object, built only from the photographed pieces.

steps.c: Place the dark red 2×2 brick on the table.
Place the red 2×2 brick six studs to the right.
Stack the green 2×2 brick on the dark red brick.
Stack the orange 2×2 brick on the red brick.
Press the brown 2×8 plate across both brick stacks.
